title: Unleash the R63 AMG

scenes.headline: 503 HP Minivan
scenes.narration: Imagine a minivan that packs 503 horsepower and hits 60 miles per hour in just 4.4 seconds.

scenes.headline: R63 AMG
scenes.narration: That's the Mercedes-Benz R63 AMG, built for speed and practicality.

scenes.headline: Airmatic Suspension
scenes.narration: Equipped with Airmatic adaptive air suspension, this R63 handles like no other minivan.

scenes.headline: Rare Production
scenes.narration: Produced only in 2007, the R63 AMG is now a rare sight with its distinctive quad exhaust tips.

scenes.headline: 6.2L V8 Engine
scenes.narration: Under the hood, the AMG M156 6.2-liter V8 engine delivers robust performance. Engineered for the E63 and S63, it fits uniquely into this minivan.

scenes.headline: Premium Interior
scenes.narration: Inside, the R63 boasts wood grain trims and a Harman/Kardon sound system accentuating its luxury.

scenes.headline: 503 vs 405 HP
scenes.narration: Against the 2009 Porsche Cayenne GTS, the R63's 503 horsepower overshadows the Cayenne's 405.

scenes.headline: Performance Craftsmanship
scenes.narration: Its engine, crafted by AMG hands, ensures bespoke performance unmatched in its class.

scenes.headline: Value Retention
scenes.narration: Originally priced at over $80,000, it sold for $64,500 recently, holding value impressive against depreciation.

scenes.headline: Performance Family Van?
scenes.narration: Is the R63 AMG’s fusion of power and utility the perfect family vehicle? Would you make it your own?

script: Imagine a minivan that packs 503 horsepower and hits 60 miles per hour in just 4.4 seconds. That's the Mercedes-Benz R63 AMG, built for speed and practicality. Equipped with Airmatic adaptive air suspension, this R63 handles like no other minivan. Produced only in 2007, the R63 AMG is now a rare sight with its distinctive quad exhaust tips. Under the hood, the AMG M156 6.2-liter V8 engine delivers robust performance. Engineered for the E63 and S63, it fits uniquely into this minivan. Inside, the R63 boasts wood grain trims and a Harman/Kardon sound system accentuating its luxury. Against the 2009 Porsche Cayenne GTS, the R63's 503 horsepower overshadows the Cayenne's 405. Its engine, crafted by AMG hands, ensures bespoke performance unmatched in its class. Originally priced at over $80,000, it sold for $64,500 recently, holding value impressive against depreciation. Is the R63 AMG’s fusion of power and utility the perfect family vehicle? Would you make it your own?

sections.Highlights: THIS... is a 2007 Mercedes-Benz R63 AMG, finished in Obsidian Black Metallic with a black interior. The attached Carfax vehicle history report shows no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this R63’s past. According to the Monroney Label provided in the gallery, notable factory equipment includes Airmatic adaptive air suspension, a panoramic sunroof, third-row seats, Distronic adaptive cruise control, and a Harman/Kardon sound system. Notable modifications reported by the seller are limited to 20-inch AMG 5-spoke wheels. One of the more unexpected products of Mercedes-Benz's range expansion during the 2000s was the W251 R-Class. It was eloquently called a "Sports Tourer" by Mercedes-Benz, but was a minivan in every aspect other than its lack of the sliding rear doors common in its segment. The extremely rare R63 AMG model featured the powerful 6.2-liter V8 that propelled the vehicle to 60 miles per hour in approximately 4.4 seconds, making it the fastest production minivan in the world. Production began in the United States in 2006 and ended after the 2013 model year. Power comes from an M156 6.2-liter V8, rated at 503 horsepower and 465 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to all four wheels via a 7-speed automatic transmission and Mercedes-Benz's 4Matic permanent all-wheel drive system.
sections.Equipment: A Monroney Label is provided in the photo gallery, and a partial list of notable equipment reported by the seller includes: Lighting Package (bi-xenon headlights with curve illumination, headlight washers, corner illuminating front foglamps) Airmatic adaptive air suspension system Panoramic sunroof Third-row seats Keyless Go Distronic adaptive cruise control Harman/Kardon sound system
sections.Seller Notes: The attached Carfax history report indicates an ownership change in March 2023. The seller reports that this is a clerical error, and they have filed a dispute claim with Carfax. The seller notes that the May 2025 service record erroneously indicates a mileage of 1,060 miles.
